title: Access switch (integration)
description: POST /api/integration/access-switch. The integration forwards a change of switch.<ns>_<name>_access made by a Home Assistant admin or an automation (the switch refuses every other user, <ns>.control refuses it as own_entity). The hub stores it, logs access_opened/access_closed with by ha, pushes the snapshot and the device's client_config. 404 unknown client, 409 no_access_switch.

user.description: Display name of the HA admin who switched (null = automation or system).
